::: {.note .reveal tabindex="0" role="button"}
[When you doubt yourself]{.note-label}

Remember who taught me to be confident. That was you, Koch. The strength I have today, I learned it by watching you. You've always had it. You still do.
:::

::: {.note .reveal tabindex="0" role="button"}
[When it's a hard day]{.note-label}

:::

[When you're happy]{.note-label}

:::

<!-- ───────────────────────── 10. LETTER ───────────────────────── -->

::: {#letter .section data-nav="Letter"}
## A Letter for You {.section-title}

[from your {{< var from.name >}}]{.section-sub}

::: letter-layout
::: {.letter-photo .reveal}
![always side by side](images/us/shadows.jpg){.lightbox}
:::

::: {.envelope-wrap .reveal}
::: {.envelope role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Open the letter"}
:::

::: letter
<!-- ✏️ Your letter -->
Ente Kocheee......

There's something I've never really said out loud, so I'm saying it here.

I wasn't always the person you see today. I didn't smile easily. I wasn't sure of myself, and I was a lot quieter than I let anyone notice.

Then there was you. You laughed like the world was never too heavy, and you believed in me long before I believed in myself.

You're the reason I learned to smile without thinking twice. Watching you stand tall, in kasavu or a jersey, on a court or on a platform all on your own, made me want to be strong too. Little by little, because of you, I became someone confident.

The confidence people see in me today? A big part of it is borrowed from you. I just never gave it back.

So whatever this year brings, I'll be right beside you, the way you've always been beside me. Side by side, like those two shadows on the road.

Happy birthday. I'm so lucky you're my sister.

[With all my love,<br>your {{< var from.name >}}]{.letter-sign}
:::
:::
:::
:::
